answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 202 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is logged against the thread challenge, the island audit can replay the signal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3825 identities would post 2342 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
